housing-numbers.notes: Plan provides for 8,900 homes over 2012-2030 period. Housing trajectory shows 400 dwellings per year 2012/13-2016/17, 495 per year 2017/18-2021/22, and 555 per year 2022/23-2029-30. Committed housing includes unimplemented planning permissions (~1,900) plus sites like Great Parks. Small windfall sites of less than 6 homes expected to provide 2,200 homes. Housing supply comes from existing commitments, identified sites for Neighbourhood Plans, and Future Growth Areas.
